verification_report.summary: All three proofs pass verification. Twenty-five ordered statement checks cover the elementary convexity lemmas, the Stone–polyhedron collapse, the finite-star–polyhedron collapse, and their Stone-parameter combination. The polyhedral triangulation argument correctly handles boundary upper semicontinuity; compact moment representations establish the junction envelope, including its additional branch-moment constraint. Partial Fenchel representation, chordal interpolation, finite covector selection, and scalar smoothing preserve full joint branch convexity. The cited local finite-star construction supplies the required quantitative majorants on a prescribed smaller neighbourhood; only its common affine collar may vary with the approximant. The countable Boolean quotient, upper-semicontinuity descent, clopen maxima, and summable-tail corrections establish decreasing approximation on one fixed product neighbourhood. The arguments cover minus-infinity values, all polyhedral faces, zero-dimensional polyhedra, and nonmetrizable transverse spaces. The CLD identification follows from the affine, smoothness, cellwise positivity, and product definitions in [Chambert–Loir–Ducros](https://webusers.imj-prg.fr/~antoine.chambert-loir/publications/papers/fdceb-20250725.pdf), especially §§1.10, 6.1–6.2, 8.1, and 9.1. The boundary-valid Fenchel–Moreau formula was also matched to [Theorem 3.1](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2203.16227). The theorem-search timeout for CLD was resolved using the primary source through web search. No critical errors or gaps remain; the claimed sheaf equalities, chartwise extension, and fixed-neighbourhood assertions follow within the stated scope.
